name: Target State
description: 10-slide target-state deck. Engine fills cover + metadata; AI writes the forces narrative (drivers from findings + risks), the target-state architecture narrative, the recommendation shaping prose, and the transition-risks summary. **Hard constraint:** each AI section lands in a fixed-height slide text frame. Drivers + transition-risks ≤ 500 chars; architecture narrative ≤ 450 chars; recommendations ≤ 600 chars. Going over makes PowerPoint shrink the text to unreadable sizes.

sections.title: Findings driving the target state
sections.purpose:
Up to 5 markdown bullets — the most material findings that motivate moving.

**Strict format:**
- Each bullet ≤ 16 words, NO sub-bullets.
- Describe issue + consequence in plain business language.
- NO `[severity/domain]` prefixes.

Total output ≤ 500 characters.

sections.title: Risks driving the target state
sections.purpose:
Up to 5 markdown bullets — risks that justify the architecture change.

**Strict format:**
- Each bullet ≤ 18 words, NO sub-bullets. Pattern: `**Risk** — materiality; why it needs architecture change, not just process.`
- NO category prefixes.

Total output ≤ 500 characters.

sections.title: Target-state architecture narrative
sections.purpose:
3–4 short sentences (≤ 80 words total) describing the proposed target architecture at a strategic level: what shape, key technology/operating-model shifts, how it addresses the forces from the prior slide.

Prose only — NO bullets, NO raw component lists. Total output ≤ 450 characters.

sections.title: Recommendations shaping the target
sections.purpose:
Up to 6 markdown bullets — recommendations that physically shape the target (architecture, platform, process). Skip purely operational/team-level recs.

**Strict format:**
- Each bullet ≤ 14 words, outcome-oriented.
- NO sub-bullets, NO priority/domain prefixes.

Total output ≤ 600 characters.

sections.title: Transition risks
sections.purpose:
Up to 5 markdown bullets — risks of MOVING (cutover failures, dual-running burden, dependency staging). Distinct from steady-state risks.

**Strict format:**
- Each bullet ≤ 18 words. Pattern: `**Risk** — one phrase on mitigation.`

Total output ≤ 500 characters.
